items.content_html: SeqRoom is a real-time collaborative step sequencer for the browser. A lightweight Node/Express server manages rooms, synchronizes transport state, and relays WebSocket events. items.content_html: A lightweight chess game implemented with pure vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features standard chess rules, special moves (castling, en passant, pawn promotion), move validation, check/checkmate detection, and game state persistence using localStorage. No frameworks, no libraries – just clean, efficient code designed for static web hosting.
